description: Implement a small function, helper or file with the LOCAL model: write the test first, then call this. The local model writes ONE file until YOUR test command passes, in an isolated git worktree. Returns only a PASS/FAIL verdict. Write the test first; the worker never sees test source, only parsed failures. Independent delegates can run in parallel. Read the diff before relying on the result.

apply.description: Copy the passing file into the checkout (default true).

context.description: Exact API surface the file may use, verbatim (names, signatures, return shapes).

model.description: Override the configured model for this call.

properties.description: Invariants that must hold for every input, ideally one per gating test.

show_code.description: Also return the code (default false: costs tokens).

spec.description: What the file must do. Resolve every ambiguity here.

target_file.description: File to create or modify, relative to the git root.

test_command.description: Shell command run in the worktree; exit 0 = pass.

test_files.description: Test files; the target may not be one of them.

name: delegate
